item.title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
item.description: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory. (3 sources: cloudflare, hackernews, javascriptweekly)

item.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
item.description: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates. We explain the impact, our response, and what customers and developers should do next. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Deploy with Void
item.description: Introducing Void: an open-source SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform for building full-stack Vite apps and deploying them to Cloudflare. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: App stability at scale with a layered defense
item.description: Introduction Artificial intelligence (AI) coding assistants have changed how fast we can ship. They have not changed how mobile users experience a crash. That gap is the pressure every mobile stability program now operates under. (1 source: grab)

item.title: Article Series: Agentic AI Architecture
item.description: In this article series, we try to establish agentic AI architecture as a new type of software architecture that will likely dominate the industry for years to come. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Article: Distributed Spring Batch Without a Message Broker
item.description: Distributed Spring Batch partitioning already needs a shared, persistent job repository. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity
item.description: Three Java Champions share how they use GitHub Copilot to solve problems, accelerate development, and keep humans responsible for the results. (1 source: githubblog)
